## The Question

What question did you explore? (The real one, not the polished version)

## AI Used

Which AI did you use? (Claude, GPT, etc. — helps understand transferability)

## Trigger Language

What activation language did you use? Did you use the suggested triggers or create your own?

## Fragments Found

What unexpected material emerged? List the fragments, even if they don't fully make sense yet.

## What Worked

Which aspects of the practice produced useful exploration?

## What Didn't Work

Where did it fall flat, feel forced, or produce noise?

## Surprises

Anything that couldn't have been predicted?

## Variations

Did you modify the practice? How?

## Session Duration

Roughly how long did the exploration take?

## Would You Do It Again?

Honest assessment — was this useful enough to repeat?

---

*Optional: Link to full session transcript if you're comfortable sharing*
